name: Amtech Esters Limited
about: Amtech Esters Limited manufactures and sells polyester resins, FRP raw materials, fiberglass reinforcement products, and industrial chemicals in India. The company offers polyester, resin, epoxy resin, polyamides and plasticizers, such as DOP, DBP, polyurethane resin and its allied products. It also offers pigment pastes, cobalt octoate, accelerators, resin hardeners, and BP pastes. In addition, the company trades in fiberglass products, including CSM 225 E, CSM 450 E/P, CSM 300 E/P, woven rovings, and chopped strands. In addition, the company provides hardeners and ancillary products, such as catalyst, cobalt, FRP cobalt, promoters, FRP brushes, wax polishes, croda pigment pastes, styrene monomers, PVA powders, French chalk powders, marble powders, and polyester films. Further, it offers silicone products, including silicone rubbers DOW, silicone hardeners, silicone oil, silicone sprays, and silicone adhesive tubes. The company serves the construction, marine, automotive, infrastructure, industrial manufacturing, and fabrication industries. Amtech Esters Limited was incorporated in 2002 and is based in Jhajjar, India.
